title: Analysis of Leftist Movement in Nepal: Ideals vs. Practice - english.ratopati.com
description: Analysis of Leftist Movement in Nepal: Ideals vs. Practice  english.ratopati.com
publisher.title: english.ratopati.com
full_article:
The evaluation of a political movement cannot be based solely on how many times it has formed a government or won elections. The true strength of any movement lies in its ideological clarity, organizational capacity, moral credibility, public trust, and its ability to introspect and transform in a timely manner.

In Nepal's modern political history, the leftist movement has played a significant role as a carrier of change, resistance, and social transformation. From the inception of the communist movement led by Pushpalal Shrestha in 2006 BS, through the Maoist People's War in 2052 BS, to the success of the left alliance in the 2074 BS elections, this movement has profoundly impacted Nepali politics. Ideals of social justice, class equality, a society free from exploitation, and socialism attracted millions of citizens, especially the youth, to the campaign for change.

It cannot be denied that the leftist movement has made a significant contribution to expanding political consciousness by building a foundation for ideological struggle against comprador capitalism, feudal structures, and social inequality. However, questions have been raised over time about the gap between principles and practice. Especially in recent years, public dissatisfaction, the changing political consciousness of the new generation, and election results have indicated the need to reconsider the established norms and practices of leftist politics.

Today's core question is not merely about the electoral success or failure of leftist parties. The question is: To what extent has socialism, equality, and social justice, as propounded by principles, been transformed in governance? To what extent have the ideals put forth by the movement been implemented in practice? In the changing national and international context, how can the Nepali leftist movement re-establish its ideological direction, organizational culture, and public trust? An objective review of these questions has become the primary need of today's political discourse.

Ideals and Ideological Basis of the Manifesto

The fundamental basis of communist philosophy is dialectical materialism. This philosophy analyzes society based on class relations, considering the contradiction between the exploiter and the exploited, and the ruler and the ruled, as the main driving force of social change. Nepali leftist parties, through their statutes, manifestos, and policies, have consistently presented social justice, equality, and socialism as their core ideological commitment.

The economic-political relations that have developed around some leftist leadership and their associates with the operation of power have further raised questions about socialist ideals. It is widely heard that parties advocating for equality are themselves becoming confined to the center of power and resources. This has more clearly exposed the gap between principles and practice.

They have set goals such as the development of national production, the end of comprador capitalism, the protection of the interests of workers and farmers, the practice of democratic centralism, and the establishment of education, health, employment, and social security as the primary responsibilities of the state.

These principles were inherently attractive, inspiring, and change-oriented. These very ideals motivated thousands of youths to participate in political movements in the past. However, as democratic practice matured, citizens began to evaluate the practical implementation of manifesto commitments rather than the commitments themselves. Consequently, the debate about the gap between principles and practice appears to be gradually strengthening.

Test of Power: The Gap Between Principles and Practice

The true evaluation of a political movement occurs not when it is in opposition, but after it assumes the responsibility of governing. This phase has also become the most difficult test for the Nepali leftist movement. The gap between the socialist ideals envisioned by principles and the practice of governance has gradually become apparent. Leftist parties had put forth the promotion of national production, the strengthening of public education and health, and the construction of a self-reliant economy as their primary policies. However, in practice, these commitments did not yield the expected results. Nepal's economy is still import-oriented, consumption-oriented, and dependent on remittances. Due to the lack of expected progress in industrialization, production growth, and job creation, millions of youths are forced to go abroad in search of employment.

On the other hand, the economic-political relations that have developed around some leftist leadership and their associates with the operation of power have further raised questions about socialist ideals. It is widely heard that parties advocating for equality are themselves becoming confined to the center of power and resources. This has more clearly exposed the gap between principles and practice.

In democratic politics, practical flexibility may be indispensable, but the question of its limits has become a significant ideological debate for the Nepali leftist movement today. Ultimately, the credibility of any political party is measured not by the frequency of alliance changes, but by its commitment to its declared principles.

Karl Marx argued that social justice is impossible without a change in production relations. Friedrich Engels considered the state as a product of historical development, while Lenin explained the party as disciplined, ideological, and accountable to the people as the basis of the socialist movement. Mao Zedong's concept of the mass line emphasizes a political culture of learning from the masses, transforming their experiences into policies, and returning to the masses. Although the perspectives of all these thinkers differ, their common conclusion is clear: the credibility of any political movement depends not merely on gaining power, but on the authenticity of its ideas, the democratic culture of its organization, and the continuity of public trust.

From Class Representation to Political Elite

From the beginning, the leftist movement built its political base by claiming to represent the peasant, labor, and working classes. However, over time, due to the lifestyle of the leadership, the practice of power, and the decision-making process, criticism has grown that a new political-economic elite has emerged within the movement. While farmers struggle with basic problems like fertilizer, seeds, irrigation, and marketing of agricultural produce, and workers demand decent wages and social security, the public perception is strengthening that the priority of political leadership has shifted from production and labor to managing power, distributing positions, and balancing power.

Such trends have created a sense of a widening gap between the commitments expressed in manifestos and the actual priorities of governance. For this reason, the argument that a re-evaluation of the relationship between the classes claimed to be represented by the leftist movement and the leadership is necessary is also gaining strength.

Practice of Democratic Centralism: Principle and Reality

The fundamental principle of communist organization is democratic centralism. Its core essence lies in open ideological debate, democratic decision-making processes, and collective discipline after decisions are made. This principle gives equal importance to internal democracy and organizational unity. However, in recent years, a strong debate has emerged that the practice of internal democracy within Nepali communist parties has weakened, and the decision-making process has become increasingly leadership-centric. Especially, the unification of the Communist Party of Nepal (CPN) in 2075 BS and its subsequent dissolution highlighted leadership struggles, power balancing, and organizational weaknesses more than ideological differences. This event has brought the question of how effectively the principle of democratic centralism has been applied in practice back to the center of debate.

Ideological Flexibility or Political Opportunism?

After accepting multi-party competitive democracy, Nepali leftist parties chose the path of gaining power through parliamentary politics. Alliances and cooperation are natural political practices in a democratic system. However, repeatedly forming power-sharing alliances with forces of different ideological leanings and changing alliances according to shifting political equations has raised questions about the ideological clarity and long-term political credibility of leftist parties. The situation of having to form a government today with forces that were strongly criticized yesterday has created ideological confusion among cadres and supporters.

In democratic politics, practical flexibility may be indispensable, but the question of its limits has become a significant ideological debate for the Nepali leftist movement today. Ultimately, the credibility of any political party is measured not by the frequency of alliance changes, but by its commitment to its declared principles.

The Constitution, Institutional Democracy, and the Question of Socialism

Nepal's constitution clearly commits to orienting the state towards a socialist-oriented political and economic direction. Therefore, respect for the spirit of the constitution, the rule of law, and democratic institutions is a shared responsibility of all political forces, not just one party. However, in recent years, issues concerning the independence of constitutional bodies, the use of ordinances, disputes over the dissolution of parliament, and political influence over key state institutions have created serious debates about democratic practice. This has made the question of whether the ideal of socialism will remain confined to constitutional declarations or be felt in the lives of citizens through democratic governance practices even more relevant.

Today, the most frequently heard words in Nepali politics are – alliance, support, vote of confidence, government change, equation, and ministry. However, issues like production, land reform, workers' rights, public education, public health, economic transformation, and socialism are increasingly felt to be fading from the center of political discourse.

The real strength of a democratic political party lies in its institutions. The central committee, standing committee, parliamentary party, provincial committees, and other statutory structures are formal centers of decision-making. However, in recent years, the public perception has strengthened that important political decisions are being made not by institutional structures but from the private residences of top leaders or informal discussions.

Informal dialogue is a natural process in democratic politics. However, when individuals, rather than institutions, become the legal centers of decision-making, institutional democracy gradually begins to weaken. In such a situation, the risk of formal party structures being limited to mere approvers of decisions rather than centers of decision-making increases. Such a trend cannot be considered positive for the long-term strengthening of democratic political culture.

Provincial Government and the Politics of Power Equations

The main objective of the federal governance system was decentralization of power, governance according to local needs, and institutionalizing democracy at the grassroots level through public participation. However, in practice, provincial governments have repeatedly fallen under the direct influence of central power equations. The trend where central political decisions become decisive in matters of chief minister changes, alliance shifts, ministry allocations, and government formation has raised questions about the political autonomy and institutional stability of the provinces. In some cases, the public perception that informal directives from top leadership are more effective than formal party structures is also strengthening.

Today, the most frequently heard words in Nepali politics are – alliance, support, vote of confidence, government change, equation, and ministry. However, issues like production, land reform, workers' rights, public education, public health, economic transformation, and socialism are increasingly felt to be fading from the center of political discourse.

This indicates that power management has taken precedence over policy debates. In this context, a serious question arises: Have the priorities of the movement truly changed, or have the practical necessities of governance temporarily sidelined the ideological agenda? If this is a temporary situation, it can be understood as political flexibility within democratic practice. However, if this trend transforms into a permanent political culture, it could pose serious questions to the ideological identity and long-term credibility of the movement.

Leadership Transition and the Expectations of the New Generation

The long-term success of any political movement is linked to leadership continuity and generational transition. Communist philosophy also accepts social change as a continuous process. Therefore, the development of new leadership, ideological renewal, and organizational transformation are considered natural necessities of the movement. However, the issue of leadership transfer in the Nepali leftist movement has been a subject of debate for a long time but has not gained expected momentum in practice. The younger generation seeks meaningful participation in policy-making, leadership development, and decision-making processes beyond the role of mere campaign workers. A movement that cannot address the changing social structure, the influence of information technology, and the political consciousness of the new generation may find it difficult to maintain long-term public trust.

International Experience: Soviet Collapse and Chinese Pragmatism

The experiences of the global communist movement offer important lessons about the rise, transformation, and fall of political movements. Particularly, the experiences of the Soviet Union and China reveal the relationship between ideology, leadership, and practice from different perspectives. Mikhail Gorbachev, the last leader of the Soviet Union, attempted reforms through Perestroika (restructuring) and Glasnost (openness). However, due to the long-standing ideological rigidity within the organization, bureaucratic culture, and the lack of timely and effective reforms in the leadership structure, the Soviet Union disintegrated in 1991. This event sent a message that no political movement can survive long-term solely on the basis of historical achievements, glorious slogans, or ideological legacy.

In contrast, China under Deng Xiaoping's leadership adopted a policy that prioritized practical results over ideological rigidity. By coordinating market mechanisms, foreign investment, technology, and the state's long-term strategic plans, economic development was made a national priority. This has provided a significant foundation for establishing China as one of the leading powers in the global economy.

These two experiences offer the same core lesson: the long-term success of any political movement depends not only on adherence to principles but also on the ability to transform oneself according to changing socio-economic realities, institutional reforms, leadership renewal, and effective performance. For the Nepali leftist movement, the most important question today is this: Can it build new trust by connecting its historical ideals with contemporary realities?

The Message from Public Mandate

In Nepal's political history, the first Constituent Assembly elections in 2064 BS and the general elections in 2074 BS provided unprecedented public support to leftist forces. The people entrusted them with a great political responsibility with expectations of stable government, good governance, economic transformation, and development. However, over time, due to the style of governance, internal disputes, leadership management, issues related to good governance, and the widening gap between public expectations, trust in traditional leftist forces has been seen to gradually weaken.

This has re-established the fact that political credibility is not maintained solely by winning elections but also depends equally on effective performance, transparency, and public accountability. Especially, the growing political consciousness among the youth, dissatisfaction with corruption, employment challenges, and expectations of good governance have increased attraction towards new political alternatives. In a democracy, public opinion is not static; if political parties fail to transform their ideology, organization, and working style in a timely manner, it is natural for voters to be attracted to new alternatives.

In this sense, the challenge before the Nepali leftist movement today is not just to achieve electoral success, but also to regain public trust by credibly transforming its declared ideals into governance, policy, and political culture. History shows that the longevity of any political movement is not guaranteed solely by past achievements; its future will be determined by self-introspection, institutional reform, leadership credibility, and the ability to transform in a timely manner. The answer to this question will also determine the future political relevance of the Nepali leftist movement.

कोनो राजनीतिक आन्दोलनक मूल्यांकन मात्र एहि बात पर नहि भ' सकैत अछि जे ओ कतेक बेर सरकार बनौलक वा चुनाव जीतलक। कोनो भी आन्दोलन के असली ताकत ओकरऽ वैचारिक स्पष्टता, संगठनात्मक क्षमता, नैतिक विश्वसनीयता, जनविश्वास, आरू समय पर आत्मनिरीक्षण आरू परिवर्तन करै के क्षमता में निहित छै ।

नेपालक आधुनिक राजनीतिक इतिहासमे वामपंथी आन्दोलन परिवर्तन, प्रतिरोध, आ सामाजिक परिवर्तनक वाहकक रूपमे महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभेने अछि । पुष्पलाल श्रेष्ठ के नेतृत्व में कम्युनिस्ट आन्दोलन के प्रारंभ स 2006 बीएस में माओवादी जनयुद्ध के माध्यम स 2074 के बीएस चुनाव में वाम गठबंधन के सफलता तक एहि आन्दोलन के नेपाली राजनीति पर गहींर प्रभाव पड़ल अछि | सामाजिक न्याय, वर्ग समानता, शोषण स॑ मुक्त समाज, आरू समाजवाद के आदर्श लाखों नागरिक खास करी क॑ युवा सिनी क॑ परिवर्तन के अभियान म॑ आकर्षित करलकै ।

ई बात स॑ इनकार नै करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै कि वामपंथी आन्दोलन न॑ कॉम्पराडोर पूंजीवाद, सामंती संरचना, आरू सामाजिक असमानता के खिलाफ वैचारिक संघर्ष के आधार बनाबै क॑ राजनीतिक चेतना के विस्तार म॑ महत्वपूर्ण योगदान देल॑ छै । मुदा समय के संग सिद्धांत आ व्यवहार के बीच के अंतर पर सवाल उठल अछि. खास करी क॑ हाल केरऽ सालऽ म॑ जन असंतोष, नया पीढ़ी केरऽ बदलतऽ राजनीतिक चेतना, आरू चुनावी परिणाम न॑ वामपंथी राजनीति केरऽ स्थापित मानदंड आरू प्रथा प॑ पुनर्विचार करै के जरूरत के संकेत देल॑ छै ।

आजुक मूल प्रश्न मात्र वामपंथी दलक चुनावी सफलता वा असफलताक नहि अछि । सवाल ई छै कि समाजवाद, समानता, आरू सामाजिक न्याय, जेना कि सिद्धांतऽ द्वारा प्रस्तावित करलऽ गेलऽ छै, शासन म॑ कतेक हद तलक बदलाव आबी गेलऽ छै ? आन्दोलन द्वारा राखल गेल आदर्श के व्यवहार मे कतेक हद तक लागू कयल गेल अछि ? बदलैत राष्ट्रीय आ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय परिप्रेक्ष्य मे नेपाली वामपंथी आन्दोलन अपन वैचारिक दिशा, संगठनात्मक संस्कृति, आ जनविश्वास के पुनः कोना स्थापित क सकैत अछि ? एहि प्रश्न सभक वस्तुनिष्ठ समीक्षा आजुक राजनीतिक प्रवचनक प्राथमिक आवश्यकता बनि गेल अछि ।

घोषणापत्र के आदर्श एवं वैचारिक आधार

साम्यवादी दर्शनक मौलिक आधार द्वंद्वात्मक भौतिकवाद अछि । ई दर्शन शोषक आरू शोषित, आरू शासक आरू शासित के बीच के विरोधाभास क॑ सामाजिक परिवर्तन के मुख्य प्रेरक शक्ति मानतें हुअ॑ वर्ग संबंधऽ के आधार प॑ समाज के विश्लेषण करै छै । नेपाली वामपंथी दल सब अपन विधान, घोषणापत्र, आ नीति के माध्यम स सामाजिक न्याय, समानता, आ समाजवाद के अपन मूल वैचारिक प्रतिबद्धता के रूप में लगातार प्रस्तुत केने अछि |

कुछ वामपंथी नेतृत्व आरू सत्ता के संचालन के साथ ओकरऽ सहयोगी के आसपास जे आर्थिक-राजनीतिक संबंध विकसित होय गेलऽ छै, ओकरा स॑ समाजवादी आदर्शऽ प॑ आरू सवाल उठी गेलऽ छै । ई बात व्यापक रूप स॑ सुनलऽ जाय छै कि समानता के वकालत करै वाला दल खुद सत्ता आरू संसाधन के केंद्र म॑ ही सीमित होय रहलऽ छै । एहि स सिद्धांत आ व्यवहार क बीच क अंतर कए बेसी स्पष्ट रूप स उजागर कैल गेल अछि।

ई सब राष्ट्रीय उत्पादन के विकास, कॉम्पडोर पूंजीवाद के अंत, मजदूर आरू किसान के हित के रक्षा, लोकतांत्रिक केंद्रवाद के अभ्यास, आरू शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, रोजगार, आरू सामाजिक सुरक्षा के स्थापना जैसनऽ लक्ष्य निर्धारित करी क॑ राज्य के प्राथमिक जिम्मेदारी के रूप म॑ रखन॑ छै ।

ई सिद्धांत सब स्वाभाविक रूप स आकर्षक, प्रेरणादायक आ परिवर्तन उन्मुख छल । यही आदर्श पूर्व में हजारों युवा के राजनीतिक आन्दोलन में भाग लेबै लेली प्रेरित करलकै । लेकिन जेना-जेना लोकतांत्रिक प्रथा परिपक्व होइत गेल, नागरिक स्वयं प्रतिबद्धता के बजाय घोषणापत्र के प्रतिबद्धता के व्यावहारिक क्रियान्वयन के मूल्यांकन करय लगलाह. फलस्वरूप सिद्धांत आरू व्यवहार के बीच के अंतर के बारे में बहस धीरे-धीरे मजबूत होय रहलऽ नजर आबी रहलऽ छै ।

सत्ता के परीक्षा : सिद्धांत एवं अभ्यास के बीच के अंतर |

कोनो राजनीतिक आन्दोलन के असली मूल्यांकन तखन नै होइत अछि जखन ओ विरोध में रहैत अछि, बल्कि ओकर शासन के जिम्मेदारी ग्रहण के बाद होइत अछि । ई चरण नेपाली वामपंथी आन्दोलनके लेल सेहो सबसँ कठिन परीक्षा बनि गेल अछि । सिद्धांत द्वारा परिकल्पित समाजवादी आदर्श आ शासन के अभ्यास के बीच के अंतर धीरे-धीरे स्पष्ट भ गेल अछि | वामपंथी दल सब राष्ट्रीय उत्पादन के बढ़ावा देबय, जनशिक्षा आ स्वास्थ्य के मजबूती, आ आत्मनिर्भर अर्थव्यवस्था के निर्माण के अपन प्राथमिक नीति के रूप में राखने छल. मुदा व्यवहार मे एहि प्रतिबद्धता स अपेक्षित परिणाम नहि भेटल। नेपालक अर्थव्यवस्था एखनो आयात उन्मुख, उपभोग उन्मुख, आ प्रेषण पर निर्भर अछि । औद्योगीकरण, उत्पादन वृद्धि, आ रोजगार सृजन में अपेक्षित प्रगति के कमी के कारण लाखों युवा रोजगार के तलाश में विदेश जेबाक लेल मजबूर छथि.

दोसरऽ तरफ कुछ वामपंथी नेतृत्व आरू सत्ता केरऽ संचालन के साथ ओकरऽ सहयोगी के आसपास जे आर्थिक-राजनीतिक संबंध विकसित होय गेलऽ छै, ओकरा स॑ समाजवादी आदर्शऽ प॑ आरू सवाल उठी गेलऽ छै । ई बात व्यापक रूप स॑ सुनलऽ जाय छै कि समानता के वकालत करै वाला दल खुद सत्ता आरू संसाधन के केंद्र म॑ ही सीमित होय रहलऽ छै । एहि स सिद्धांत आ व्यवहार क बीच क अंतर कए बेसी स्पष्ट रूप स उजागर कैल गेल अछि।

लोकतांत्रिक राजनीति मे व्यावहारिक लचीलापन अनिवार्य भ सकैत अछि, मुदा एकर सीमाक प्रश्न आइ नेपाली वामपंथी आन्दोलन लेल एकटा महत्वपूर्ण वैचारिक बहस बनि गेल अछि । अंततः कोनो भी राजनीतिक दल के विश्वसनीयता के माप गठबंधन परिवर्तन के आवृत्ति स॑ नै, बल्कि ओकरऽ घोषित सिद्धांतऽ के प्रति प्रतिबद्धता स॑ होय छै ।

कार्ल मार्क्स केरऽ तर्क छेलै कि उत्पादन संबंधऽ म॑ बदलाव के बिना सामाजिक न्याय असंभव छै । फ्रेडरिक एंगेल्स राज्य क॑ ऐतिहासिक विकास केरऽ उपज मानलकै, जबकि लेनिन न॑ पार्टी क॑ समाजवादी आन्दोलन के आधार के रूप म॑ अनुशासित, वैचारिक आरू जनता के सामने जवाबदेह बतैलकै । माओत्से तुंग केरऽ जन रेखा के अवधारणा जनमानस स॑ सीखै के राजनीतिक संस्कृति प॑ जोर दै छै, ओकरऽ अनुभव क॑ नीति म॑ बदलै के, आरू जनमानस म॑ वापसी करै के । भले ही ई सब विचारक के दृष्टिकोण अलग-अलग छै, लेकिन हुनकऽ साझा निष्कर्ष स्पष्ट छै कि कोनो भी राजनीतिक आन्दोलन के विश्वसनीयता खाली सत्ता प्राप्त करै पर नै, बल्कि ओकरऽ विचार के प्रामाणिकता, ओकरऽ संगठन के लोकतांत्रिक संस्कृति, आरू जनविश्वास के निरंतरता पर निर्भर करै छै ।

वर्ग प्रतिनिधित्व से राजनीतिक अभिजात वर्ग तक

शुरूए सॅं वामपंथी आन्दोलन किसान, मजदूर, मजदूर वर्गक प्रतिनिधित्व करबाक दावा कए अपन राजनीतिक आधार बनौलक । लेकिन समय के साथ नेतृत्व के जीवनशैली, सत्ता के अभ्यास, आरू निर्णय प्रक्रिया के कारण आलोचना बढ़ी गेलऽ छै कि आन्दोलन के भीतर एगो नया राजनीतिक-आर्थिक अभिजात वर्ग के उदय होय गेलऽ छै । किसान जहाँ खाद, बीज, सिंचाई, आरू कृषि उपज के विपणन जैसनऽ मूलभूत समस्या स॑ जूझै छै, आरू मजदूर सभ्य मजदूरी आरू सामाजिक सुरक्षा के मांग करै छै, वहीं ई जनधारणा मजबूत होय रहलऽ छै कि राजनीतिक नेतृत्व के प्राथमिकता उत्पादन आरू श्रम स॑ सत्ता के प्रबंधन, पद के वितरण, आरू सत्ता के संतुलन बनाबै के तरफ बढ़ी गेलऽ छै ।

ऐन्हऽ प्रवृत्ति न॑ घोषणा पत्रऽ म॑ व्यक्त प्रतिबद्धता आरू शासन केरऽ वास्तविक प्राथमिकता के बीच बढ़तऽ अंतर के भाव पैदा करी देल॑ छै । यही कारण स॑ ई तर्क भी मजबूत होय रहलऽ छै कि वामपंथी आन्दोलन आरू नेतृत्व केरऽ प्रतिनिधित्व करै के दावा करलऽ गेलऽ वर्गऽ के बीच के संबंध के पुनर्मूल्यांकन जरूरी छै ।

लोकतांत्रिक केंद्रवाद के अभ्यास : सिद्धांत एवं यथार्थ

साम्यवादी संगठन के मौलिक सिद्धांत लोकतांत्रिक केंद्रवाद अछि | एकरऽ मूल सार खुला वैचारिक बहस, लोकतांत्रिक निर्णय प्रक्रिया, आरू निर्णय लेला के बाद सामूहिक अनुशासन म॑ छै । ई सिद्धांत आन्तरिक लोकतंत्र आ संगठनात्मक एकता के समान महत्व दैत अछि | लेकिन हाल के वर्षो में एक मजबूत बहस उठल छै कि नेपाली कम्युनिस्ट दल के भीतर आतंरिक लोकतंत्र के प्रथा कमजोर होय गेलऽ छै, आरू निर्णय लेबै के प्रक्रिया तेजी सें नेतृत्व केंद्रित होय गेलऽ छै । खास करी क॑ २०७५ बीएस म॑ नेपाल कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी (नेकपा) केरऽ एकीकरण आरू ओकरऽ बाद ओकरऽ विघटन न॑ वैचारिक मतभेद स॑ बेसी नेतृत्व संघर्ष, सत्ता संतुलन, आरू संगठनात्मक कमजोरी प॑ प्रकाश डाललकै । ई आयोजन न॑ ई सवाल क॑ बहस के केंद्र म॑ लानल॑ छै कि लोकतांत्रिक केंद्रवाद के सिद्धांत क॑ व्यवहार म॑ कतेक प्रभावी ढंग स॑ लागू करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

वैचारिक लचीलापन आकि राजनीतिक अवसरवाद ?

बहुदलीय प्रतिस्पर्धी लोकतंत्र स्वीकार केलाक बाद नेपाली वामपंथी दल संसदीय राजनीति के माध्यम स सत्ता प्राप्त करबाक मार्ग चुनलक । लोकतांत्रिक व्यवस्था मे गठबंधन आ सहयोग स्वाभाविक राजनीतिक प्रथा अछि । लेकिन, बार-बार अलग-अलग वैचारिक झुकाव के ताकतऽ के साथ सत्ता-साझेदारी के गठबंधन बनाबै आरू बदलतऽ राजनीतिक समीकरण के अनुसार गठबंधन बदलै स॑ वामपंथी दलऽ के वैचारिक स्पष्टता आरू दीर्घकालिक राजनीतिक विश्वसनीयता प॑ सवाल उठी गेलऽ छै । काल्हि कड़ा आलोचना भेल शक्ति सभक संग आइ सरकार बनेबाक स्थिति कार्यकर्ता आ समर्थक मे वैचारिक भ्रम उत्पन्न कएने अछि ।

लोकतांत्रिक राजनीति मे व्यावहारिक लचीलापन अनिवार्य भ सकैत अछि, मुदा एकर सीमाक प्रश्न आइ नेपाली वामपंथी आन्दोलन लेल एकटा महत्वपूर्ण वैचारिक बहस बनि गेल अछि । अंततः कोनो भी राजनीतिक दल के विश्वसनीयता के माप गठबंधन परिवर्तन के आवृत्ति स॑ नै, बल्कि ओकरऽ घोषित सिद्धांतऽ के प्रति प्रतिबद्धता स॑ होय छै ।

संविधान, संस्थागत लोकतंत्र, एवं समाजवाद का प्रश्न |

नेपालक संविधान समाजवादी उन्मुख राजनीतिक आ आर्थिक दिशा दिस राज्य उन्मुख करबाक लेल स्पष्ट रूप सँ प्रतिबद्ध अछि । अतः संविधान, कानून के राज, लोकतांत्रिक संस्था के भावना के सम्मान सिर्फ एक दल के नै, सब राजनीतिक शक्ति के साझा जिम्मेदारी छै । लेकिन हाल के सालऽ म॑ संवैधानिक निकायऽ के स्वतंत्रता, अध्यादेश के प्रयोग, संसद के विघटन के विवाद, आरू प्रमुख राज्य संस्थानऽ प॑ राजनीतिक प्रभाव स॑ संबंधित मुद्दा न॑ लोकतांत्रिक व्यवहार के बारे म॑ गंभीर बहस पैदा करी देल॑ छै । एहि स समाजवाद क आदर्श संवैधानिक घोषणा तक सीमित रहत या लोकतांत्रिक शासन प्रथा क माध्यम स नागरिक क जीवन मे महसूस कैल जाएत, इ सवाल आओर प्रासंगिक भ गेल अछि।

आइ नेपाली राजनीति मे सबसँ बेसी सुनल जायवला शब्द अछि – गठबंधन, समर्थन, विश्वास मत, सरकार परिवर्तन, समीकरण, आ मंत्रालय । लेकिन उत्पादन, भूमि सुधार, मजदूर अधिकार, जनशिक्षा, जनस्वास्थ्य, आर्थिक परिवर्तन, आरू समाजवाद जैसनऽ मुद्दा राजनीतिक प्रवचन के केंद्र स॑ फीका होय रहलऽ महसूस होय रहलऽ छै ।

लोकतांत्रिक राजनीतिक दलक असली ताकत ओकर संस्था मे अछि । केंद्रीय समिति, स्थायी समिति, संसदीय दल, प्रांतीय समिति, आरू अन्य वैधानिक संरचना निर्णय लेबै के औपचारिक केंद्र छै । लेकिन हाल के सालऽ म॑ ई जनधारणा मजबूत होय गेलऽ छै कि महत्वपूर्ण राजनीतिक निर्णय संस्थागत संरचना स॑ नै बल्कि शीर्ष नेता सिनी के निजी आवास या अनौपचारिक चर्चा स॑ होय रहलऽ छै ।

लोकतांत्रिक राजनीति मे अनौपचारिक संवाद एकटा स्वाभाविक प्रक्रिया अछि । मुदा, जखन संस्थाक बजाय व्यक्ति निर्णय लेबाक कानूनी केंद्र बनि जाइत अछि तखन संस्थागत लोकतंत्र धीरे-धीरे कमजोर होबय लगैत अछि । ऐन्हऽ स्थिति म॑ औपचारिक पार्टी संरचना के निर्णय लेबै के केंद्र के बजाय खाली फैसला के अनुमोदन करै वाला तक सीमित होय के खतरा बढ़ी जाय छै । लोकतांत्रिक राजनीतिक संस्कृति के दीर्घकालीन मजबूती के लेल एहन प्रवृत्ति सकारात्मक नै मानल जा सकैत अछि ।

प्रांतीय सरकार एवं सत्ता समीकरण की राजनीति

संघीय शासन प्रणाली के मुख्य उद्देश्य सत्ता के विकेंद्रीकरण, स्थानीय आवश्यकता के अनुसार शासन, आ जनसहभागिता के माध्यम स जमीनी स्तर पर लोकतंत्र के संस्थागत करब छल | लेकिन व्यवहार में प्रांतीय सरकार बार-बार केंद्रीय शक्ति समीकरण के प्रत्यक्ष प्रभाव में आबी गेलऽ छै । मुख्यमंत्री परिवर्तन, गठबंधन परिवर्तन, मंत्रालय आवंटन, आरू सरकार केरऽ गठन के मामला म॑ केंद्रीय राजनीतिक फैसला निर्णायक होय जाय छै, जेकरा स॑ प्रांतऽ के राजनीतिक स्वायत्तता आरू संस्थागत स्थिरता प॑ सवाल उठी गेलऽ छै । कुछ मामला म॑ ई जन धारणा भी मजबूत होय रहलऽ छै कि शीर्ष नेतृत्व केरऽ अनौपचारिक निर्देश औपचारिक पार्टी संरचना स॑ अधिक प्रभावी छै ।

आइ नेपाली राजनीति मे सबसँ बेसी सुनल जायवला शब्द अछि – गठबंधन, समर्थन, विश्वास मत, सरकार परिवर्तन, समीकरण, आ मंत्रालय । लेकिन उत्पादन, भूमि सुधार, मजदूर अधिकार, जनशिक्षा, जनस्वास्थ्य, आर्थिक परिवर्तन, आरू समाजवाद जैसनऽ मुद्दा राजनीतिक प्रवचन के केंद्र स॑ फीका होय रहलऽ महसूस होय रहलऽ छै ।

ई संकेत करै छै कि नीतिगत बहस स॑ बेसी बिजली प्रबंधन क॑ प्राथमिकता देलऽ गेलऽ छै । एहि संदर्भ मे एकटा गंभीर प्रश्न उठैत अछि जे की सही मायने मे आन्दोलनक प्राथमिकता मे बदलाव आयल अछि, वा शासनक व्यावहारिक आवश्यकता वैचारिक एजेंडा केँ अस्थायी रूप सँ किनारा क' देलक अछि ? यदि ई अस्थायी स्थिति छै त॑ एकरा लोकतांत्रिक व्यवहार के भीतर राजनीतिक लचीलापन के रूप म॑ समझलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै । लेकिन अगर ई प्रवृत्ति स्थायी राजनीतिक संस्कृति म॑ बदली जाय छै त॑ ई आन्दोलन केरऽ वैचारिक पहचान आरू दीर्घकालिक विश्वसनीयता प॑ गंभीर सवाल पैदा करी सकै छै ।

नेतृत्व संक्रमण एवं नई पीढ़ी की अपेक्षाएँ |

कोनो भी राजनीतिक आन्दोलन के दीर्घकालिक सफलता नेतृत्व के निरंतरता आरू पीढ़ी के संक्रमण स॑ जुड़लऽ छै । साम्यवादी दर्शन सेहो सामाजिक परिवर्तन के एकटा निरंतर प्रक्रिया के रूप में स्वीकार करैत अछि | अतः नव नेतृत्व के विकास, वैचारिक नवीकरण, आ संगठनात्मक परिवर्तन आन्दोलन के स्वाभाविक आवश्यकता मानल जाइत अछि | मुदा नेपाली वामपंथी आन्दोलनमे नेतृत्व स्थानान्तरणके मुद्दा बहुत दिनसँ बहसके विषय रहल अछि मुदा व्यवहारमे अपेक्षित गति नहि भेटल अछि । युवा पीढ़ी खाली अभियान कार्यकर्ता के भूमिका स॑ परे नीति निर्माण, नेतृत्व विकास, आरू निर्णय लेबै के प्रक्रिया म॑ सार्थक भागीदारी के तलाश करै छै । जे आन्दोलन बदलैत सामाजिक संरचना, सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी के प्रभाव, आरू नया पीढ़ी के राजनीतिक चेतना के संबोधित नै करी सकै छै, ओकरा दीर्घकालिक जनविश्वास कायम रखना मुश्किल होय सकै छै ।

अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अनुभव : सोवियत पतन एवं चीनी व्यावहारिकतावाद

वैश्विक साम्यवादी आन्दोलन के अनुभव राजनीतिक आन्दोलन के उदय, परिवर्तन, आरू पतन के बारे में महत्वपूर्ण सबक दै छै । खास करी क॑ सोवियत संघ आरू चीन केरऽ अनुभव स॑ विचारधारा, नेतृत्व आरू व्यवहार के बीच के संबंध अलग-अलग दृष्टिकोण स॑ पता चलै छै । सोवियत संघ केरऽ अंतिम नेता मिखाइल गोरबाचेव न॑ पेरेस्ट्रोइका (पुनर्गठन) आरू ग्लासनोस्ट (खुलापन) के माध्यम स॑ सुधार के कोशिश करलकै । लेकिन संगठन के भीतर लंबा समय स॑ वैचारिक कठोरता, नौकरशाही संस्कृति, आरू नेतृत्व संरचना म॑ समय पर आरू प्रभावी सुधार के कमी के कारण १९९१ म॑ सोवियत संघ के विघटन होय ​​गेलै ।ई घटना स॑ ई संदेश मिललै कि कोय भी राजनीतिक आन्दोलन केवल ऐतिहासिक उपलब्धि, गौरवशाली नारा, या वैचारिक विरासत के आधार प॑ दीर्घकालिक रूप स॑ नै बच॑ सकै छै ।

एकरऽ विपरीत चीन न॑ डेंग जिओपिंग केरऽ नेतृत्व म॑ एगो ऐसनऽ नीति अपनालकै जेकरा म॑ वैचारिक कठोरता स॑ बेसी व्यावहारिक परिणाम क॑ प्राथमिकता देलऽ गेलै । बाजार तंत्र, विदेशी निवेश, तकनीक, आरू राज्य केरऽ दीर्घकालिक रणनीतिक योजना के समन्वय करी क॑ आर्थिक विकास क॑ राष्ट्रीय प्राथमिकता बनैलऽ गेलै । ई चीन क॑ वैश्विक अर्थव्यवस्था केरऽ प्रमुख शक्ति म॑ स॑ एक के रूप म॑ स्थापित करै लेली एगो महत्वपूर्ण आधार प्रदान करलकै ।

ई दूनू अनुभव एक ही मूल पाठ दै छै : कोनो भी राजनीतिक आंदोलन के दीर्घकालिक सफलता न सिर्फ सिद्धांत के पालन पर निर्भर करै छै बल्कि बदलतऽ सामाजिक-आर्थिक वास्तविकता, संस्थागत सुधार, नेतृत्व के नवीकरण, आरू प्रभावी प्रदर्शन के अनुसार खुद क॑ बदलै के क्षमता प॑ भी निर्भर करै छै । नेपाली वामपंथी आन्दोलन लेल आइ सबसँ महत्वपूर्ण प्रश्न ई अछि जे की ओ अपन ऐतिहासिक आदर्श केँ समकालीन यथार्थ सँ जोड़ि नव विश्वासक निर्माण क' सकैत अछि ?

सार्वजनिक जनादेश से संदेश

नेपालक राजनीतिक इतिहासमे २०६४ वि.स.मे पहिल संविधानसभा निर्वाचन आ २०७४ वि.स.मे भेल आम निर्वाचन वामपंथी शक्तिके अभूतपूर्व जनसमर्थन प्रदान केलक । जनता हुनका सब के स्थिर सरकार, सुशासन, आर्थिक परिवर्तन, आ विकास के अपेक्षा के संग एकटा पैघ राजनीतिक जिम्मेदारी सौंपलक | लेकिन समय के साथ शासन के शैली, आंतरिक विवाद, नेतृत्व प्रबंधन, सुशासन स॑ जुड़लऽ मुद्दा, आरू जन अपेक्षा के बीच बढ़तऽ अंतर के कारण पारंपरिक वामपंथी ताकतऽ प॑ विश्वास धीरे-धीरे कमजोर होय रहलऽ देखलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

ई तथ्य क॑ फेर स॑ स्थापित करी देल॑ छै कि राजनीतिक विश्वसनीयता खाली चुनाव जीतला स॑ ही नै बनलऽ रहै छै बल्कि प्रभावी प्रदर्शन, पारदर्शिता, आरू जन जवाबदेही प॑ भी समान रूप स॑ निर्भर करै छै । खास करी क॑ युवा सिनी के बीच बढ़तऽ राजनीतिक चेतना, भ्रष्टाचार स॑ असंतोष, रोजगार के चुनौती, आरू सुशासन के उम्मीद के वजह स॑ नया राजनीतिक विकल्प के प्रति आकर्षण बढ़ी गेलऽ छै । लोकतंत्र में जनमत स्थिर नहिं होइत छैक; अगर राजनीतिक दल समय पर अपनऽ विचारधारा, संगठन, आरू काम करै के शैली म॑ बदलाव नै आबै छै त॑ मतदाता के नया विकल्प के तरफ आकर्षित होना स्वाभाविक छै ।

एहि अर्थ मे आइ नेपाली वामपंथी आन्दोलनक समक्ष चुनौती मात्र चुनावी सफलता प्राप्त करब नहि, अपितु अपन घोषित आदर्श केँ विश्वसनीय रूप सँ शासन, नीति, आ राजनीतिक संस्कृति मे बदलि जनविश्वास वापस प्राप्त करब सेहो अछि । इतिहास ई दर्शाबै छै कि कोनो भी राजनीतिक आन्दोलन के दीर्घायु के गारंटी केवल विगत उपलब्धि स॑ नै मिलै छै; एकरऽ भविष्य आत्म-अंतर्निरीक्षण, संस्थागत सुधार, नेतृत्व केरऽ विश्वसनीयता, आरू समय पर परिवर्तन करै के क्षमता स॑ निर्धारित होतै । एहि प्रश्नक उत्तर नेपाली वामपंथी आन्दोलनक भविष्यक राजनीतिक प्रासंगिकता सेहो निर्धारित करत ।

On Sunday, Foreign Ministry sources said Shah will meet Indian Ambassador Naveen Srivastava on Monday morning and Chinese Ambassador Zhang Maoming later that afternoon.

It will be followed by a meeting with the US Embassy Chargé d’Affaires Scott Urbom on Tuesday and other envoys.

“The Indian ambassador is told to come first, followed by the Chinese ambassador. So both ambassadors are meeting the prime minister on the same day, but the earlier and later timings also show the foreign policy priority of the government,” a senior Foreign Ministry official told The Kathmandu Post.

The Foreign Ministry has communicated the appointments to the respective embassies, the Post said quoting a prime ministerial adviser.

The agenda is expected to be largely introductory, with the ambassadors briefing Shah on the state of bilateral relations and conveying any messages from their respective governments, it said.

The meetings on Monday and Tuesday were delayed due to recent communal violence in Terai and Madhesh region.

The prime minister had earlier avoided one-on-one engagements and even declined to meet the US Assistant Secretary of State for South and Central Asian Affairs Samir Paul Kapur and President Donald Trump’s special envoy for South and Central Asia Sergio Gor.

PM Shah had also not undertaken any visit to either the southern or the northern neighbour and instead Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal made back-to-back visits to New Delhi and Beijing in June.

Khanal had earlier said Nepal wants to build stronger and deeper relations with both India and China, describing the southern and northern neighbours as vital partners for the Himalayan nation and recently said Nepal wants to transform itself from a landlocked country into a “vibrant, dynamic bridge” connecting the two neighbours.

“The Indian ambassador is told to come first, followed by the Chinese ambassador. So both ambassadors are meeting the prime minister on the same day, but the earlier and later timings also show the foreign policy priority of the government,” a senior Foreign Ministry official told The Kathmandu Post.

The Foreign Ministry has communicated the appointments to the respective embassies, the Post said quoting a prime ministerial adviser.

The agenda is expected to be largely introductory, with the ambassadors briefing Mr. Shah on the state of bilateral relations and conveying any messages from their respective governments, it said.

The meetings were delayed due to recent communal violence in Terai and Madhesh region.

The Prime Minister had earlier avoided one-on-one engagements and even declined to meet the U.S. Assistant Secretary of State for South and Central Asian Affairs Samir Paul Kapur and President Donald Trump’s special envoy for South and Central Asia Sergio Gor.

Mr. Shah broke his self-imposed rule by holding a one-on-one meeting with Asian Development Bank President Masato Kanda, who visited Nepal for three days beginning July 6.

PM Shah had also not undertaken any visit to either the southern or the northern neighbour and instead Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal made back-to-back visits to New Delhi and Beijing in June.

Mr. Khanal had earlier said Nepal wants to build stronger and deeper relations with both India and China, describing the southern and northern neighbours as vital partners for the Himalayan nation and recently said Nepal wants to transform itself from a landlocked country into a “vibrant, dynamic bridge” connecting the two neighbours.

title: Nepal Ski Association Approves Budget of NPR 3.48 Million for Fiscal Year 2083/84 - Ratopati
description: Nepal Ski Association Approves Budget of NPR 3.48 Million for Fiscal Year 2083/84  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. The seventh general assembly of the Nepal Ski Association has passed an annual budget of NPR 3,480,800 for the fiscal year 2083/84. The closed session of the association, held on Sunday, approved the budget by prioritizing the organization of national competitions, participation in international competitions and programs, training programs, and preparation for the Winter Olympics.

The closed session, held under the chairmanship of the association's president, Jivanram Shrestha, also approved the action plan presented by Vice President Rama Bhattarai, the annual report of General Secretary Vijay Shrestha, and the financial report presented by Treasurer Jitendra Shrestha.

The general assembly also decided to appoint a new auditor. Accordingly, BR Parajuli & Associates has been selected as the auditor of the association. It was also decided to hold the regular general assembly next year.

As per the new statute of the association, arrangements have been made for officials and members who cannot be physically present to participate in the general assembly through virtual means as well. In accordance with this arrangement, officials and members participated in the general assembly through both physical and virtual means.

At the program, President Shrestha stated that due to the instability seen in the sports sector, Nepali sports have not been able to achieve the height and success they should have. He expressed the view that if all parties worked honestly according to their responsibilities and legal provisions, the instability seen in the sports sector would end.

Although there is great potential for skiing in Nepal, the association has stated that there is still a lot of work to be done in areas such as infrastructure, training, and international participation for its development. The association's Vice President, Rama Bhattarai, expressed gratitude to all who are supporting the promotion of skiing.

General Secretary Vijay Shrestha said that although there are various challenges for the operation and development of skiing in Nepal, the association is working to promote the sport by utilizing the available possibilities to the fullest.

On the occasion of the general assembly, the Nepal Ski Association also released the first issue of the 'Snowline' magazine. The magazine, which includes activities of skiing and related articles, was jointly unveiled by the association's president Shrestha and other guests present at the program.

The association's plan is to increase participation in international competitions along with the development of skiing in Nepal, provide training opportunities to players, and prepare for the upcoming Winter Olympics.

महासचिव विजय श्रेष्ठ कहलनि जे, नेपाल मे स्कीइंग के संचालन आ विकास के लेल विभिन्न तरहक चुनौती अछि, मुदा उपलब्ध संभावना के पूर्ण उपयोग क संघ एहि खेल के बढ़ावा देबय लेल काज क रहल अछि।

आम सभा के अवसर पर नेपाल स्की संघ ‘स्नोलाइन’ पत्रिका के पहिल अंक सेहो जारी केलक । स्कीइंग के गतिविधि आरू संबंधित लेख समेटै वाला ई पत्रिका के अनावरण संघ के अध्यक्ष श्रेष्ठ आरू कार्यक्रम म॑ उपस्थित अन्य अतिथि सिनी न॑ संयुक्त रूप स॑ करलकै ।

संघ केरऽ योजना नेपाल म॑ स्कीइंग के विकास के साथ-साथ अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतियोगिता म॑ भी भागीदारी बढ़ाबै के, खिलाड़ी सिनी क॑ प्रशिक्षण के अवसर प्रदान करै के, आरू आगामी शीतकालीन ओलंपिक के तैयारी करै के छै ।

full_article:
Cultivation of marijuana has always been illegal in Nepal but a controversial bill allowing the cultivation and medical use of cannabis, was endorsed by the chief of Nepal's Gandaki province, which shares its borders with neighbouring Bihar's West Champaran district at Valmikinagar, a tiger reserve area.

The bill was unanimously passed by province assembly members from the ruling coalition and opposition parties, reported Associated Press.

Gandaki is one of Nepal's seven provinces which is home to some of the country's most popular mountains and hiking trails, as well as the resort city of Pokhara.

full_article:
Several political, diplomatic and security developments were reported across South Asia and beyond on Sunday, with Bangladesh, Nepal and Pakistan-occupied Kashmir in focus, while China issued its highest typhoon warning, a murder arrest was made in Canada, and Yemen's Houthis claimed an attack in Saudi Arabia.

The updates included a suggestion from India's envoy in Dhaka that a meeting between Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and Prime Minister Narendra Modi could ease strains in ties, planned meetings by Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah 'Balen' with the Indian and Chinese ambassadors, and a new eight-party alliance in Nepal called the 'Progressive Front'.

In Dhaka, Indian High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi said a meeting between Rahman and Modi could help resolve problems in bilateral relations between Bangladesh and India.

In Pakistan-occupied Kashmir, the PML(N) of Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and his brother Nawaz appeared to be on the back foot as it prepared to take charge of the so-called government in the region. The party described the protesters there as "patriots" after months of violence.

In China, the national observatory issued a red alert, the highest level in the country's typhoon warning system, as Typhoon Dolphin hit Zhejiang province on the eastern coast on Sunday afternoon.

In Nepal, Prime Minister Shah is set to hold separate bilateral meetings on Monday with the Indian and Chinese ambassadors to the country. The meetings will focus on bilateral relations and will be his first one-on-one diplomatic engagements in more than 100 days in office.

Also in Nepal, eight political parties announced the formation of a new alliance, the 'Progressive Front', based on "shared political issues and common agendas".

In Canada, a 32-year-old man was arrested in Toronto for allegedly killing an Indian woman, who was his partner, seven months after her murder, according to a local media report.

A study in China said the Communist Party has long presented the protection of women's rights as one of its achievements, but found that women's role in public life has reduced in recent years, especially at the highest levels of political and policy leadership.

In Yemen, the Houthis said they had attacked an Aramco oil facility in south-western Saudi Arabia on Sunday, in what they described as their latest attack on the kingdom.

Taken together, the developments pointed to a day shaped by diplomatic contacts, political shifts, extreme weather and security-related incidents across the region and beyond.

title: Nepal puts Tibetan refugee population at over 3,500 - Tibetan Review
description: Nepal puts Tibetan refugee population at over 3,500  Tibetan Review
publisher.title: Tibetan Review
full_article:
(TibetanReview.net, Aug09’26) – The police in Nepal have put the number of Tibetan refugees living in the country at over 3,500, the second largest group after Bhutanese refugees, with the total being over 10,000, reported myrepublica.nagariknetwork.com Aug 7. The report said the police made the figures public after misleading comments and discussions about refugees began circulating on social media.

The report cited police spokesperson Abi Narayan Kafle as saying 6,272 Bhutanese refugees were currently living in Nepal.

Kafle has put the number of Tibetan refugees living in the country, per police data, at 3,527, followed by 527 Rohingya refugees.

The vast majority of Tibetan refugees living in the country remain unregistered and therefore uncounted. Nepal stopped registering Tibetan refugees decades ago due to pressure from China which insists they are illegal migrants.

The refugees from Bhutan are ethnically Nepali (known as Lhotshampas) and the vast majority of their original total of over 1,00,000 – expelled between 1988 and 1993 – have been resettled in the West, starting in 2007. They were mostly taken in by the United States (85,000 individuals). The other counties included Australia, Canada, United Kingdom, New Zealand, Denmark, and The Netherlands.

The Himalayan kingdom threw them out as illegal migrants and, reportedly, in a political crackdown.

title: 32nd International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples - The Rising Nepal
description: 32nd International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug 9: President Ramchandra Paudel reminded that the country's Constitution has ensured rights to all communities by acknowledging unity in diversity.

Addressing a programme organised by the Indigenous Nationalities Commission on the occasion of the 32nd International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples, the-Head-of-State said, "Nepal is a country with multi-case, multi-language, multi-religious and multicultural features." The unique identity and culture of the indigenous people who have been living here since ancient times remain as the national pride of Nepal, according to him.

Paudel said, “The indigenous peoples are the children of this land and have a lasting, inner and deeper connection with water, land and natural resources.” The President said it is the government's responsibility to ensure the meaningful participation of indigenous nationalities at the policy and decision-making levels. He added that the latest data shows an encouraging 36.8 percent participation of indigenous communities at the local level.

He said he believed that access to education for these communities should be further increased to promote their overall advancement. Nepal is in the forefront in the international forum in view of the protection and promotion of indigenous rights and it is the first country in the entire South Asia to endorse ILO Convention No 169.

The President, reiterating full commitments to the United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples and the Convention on Biological Diversity, said these international documents recognize rights and cultural independence of indigenous nationalities. It is noted that Indigenous and Tribal Peoples Convention, 1989 (No. 169) is a major international treaty adopted by the International Labour Organization (ILO) on June 27, 1989 which exclusively promotes rights, cultures, lands, and the way of life of indigenous and tribal peoples.

Since the establishment of the federal democratic republic system in the country, Nepal has through the Constitution, provisioned for the establishment of the 'Indigenous Nationalities Commission', the President said. He expressed confidence that this constitutional body is championing on the empowerment of indigenous peoples by protecting their glorious history, language, and culture, and that it will continue to play its role more effectively.

According to the President, journey towards a prosperous Nepal will remain incomplete in absence of justice to and rights of indigenous nationalities." National integrity will be further reinforced by addressing remnants of past conflicts and dissatisfactions through democratic dialogues and constitutional procedures and promoting durable peace, maintaining community goodwill and unity."

"We should not forget that rights of all castes, classes and the backward communities have been ensured in democracy," he underscored.

Underlining the need to economically empower the indigenous nationalities through the commercial transformations of their indigenous knowledge, skills and technology, the President pressed the need to pursue a policy of securing economic advantages by connecting indigenous culture to tourism through the implementation of innovative approaches like 'open-air living museum'.(RSS)

विश्व आदिवासी जनजातिक ३२म अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय दिवसके अवसरमे आदिवासी राष्ट्रियता आयोगद्वारा आयोजित कार्यक्रमके सम्बोधन करैत राष्ट्राध्यक्ष कहलनि जे, नेपाल बहुप्रकरण, बहुभाषी, बहुधार्मिक आ बहुसांस्कृतिक विशेषता वाला देश अछि । प्राचीन काल सँ एतय रहनिहार आदिवासी लोकनिक विशिष्ट पहिचान आ संस्कृति नेपालक राष्ट्रीय गौरवक रूप मे बनल अछि, हुनक अनुसार ।

पौडेल कहलकै, “आदिवासी लोगऽ के ई भूमि के संतान छै आरू पानी, जमीन आरू प्राकृतिक संसाधनऽ स॑ एकरऽ स्थायी, आतंरिक आरू गहरा संबंध छै।” राष्ट्रपति नँ कहलकै कि नीति आरू निर्णय लेबै के स्तर प आदिवासी राष्ट्रीयता के सार्थक भागीदारी सुनिश्चित करना सरकार के जिम्मेदारी छै । हुनी आरू कहलकै कि ताजा आंकड़ा स्थानीय स्तर प आदिवासी समुदाय के उत्साहजनक 36.8 प्रतिशत भागीदारी के दर्शाबै छै ।

हुनी कहलकै कि हुनकऽ मानना ​​छै कि ई समुदायऽ लेली शिक्षा के पहुँच आरू बढ़ाबै के चाही ताकि हुनकऽ समग्र उन्नति बढ़ैलऽ जाय सक॑ । नेपाल आदिवासी अधिकार के संरक्षण आरू संवर्धन के दृष्टि स॑ अंतरराष्ट्रीय मंच म॑ सबसें आगू छै आरू पूरा दक्षिण एशिया म॑ आईएलओ केरऽ कन्वेंशन नंबर १६९ के समर्थन करै वाला ई पहिलऽ देश छेकै ।

राष्ट्रपति न॑ संयुक्त राष्ट्र केरऽ आदिवासी लोगऽ के अधिकारऽ के घोषणापत्र आरू जैविक विविधता महासन्धि के प्रति पूर्ण प्रतिबद्धता क॑ दोहरबैत॑ कहलकै कि ई अंतर्राष्ट्रीय दस्तावेज आदिवासी राष्ट्रीयता के अधिकार आरू सांस्कृतिक स्वतंत्रता क॑ मान्यता दै छै । ध्यान देलऽ जाय छै कि आदिवासी आरू आदिवासी लोगऽ के सम्मेलन, १९८९ (संख्या १६९) अंतर्राष्ट्रीय श्रम संगठन (आईएलओ) द्वारा २७ जून, १९८९ क॑ अपनालऽ गेलऽ एगो प्रमुख अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संधि छै जे विशेष रूप स॑ आदिवासी आरू आदिवासी लोगऽ के अधिकार, संस्कृति, भूमि, आरू जीवनशैली क॑ बढ़ावा दै छै ।

देशमे संघीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्र व्यवस्था स्थापना भेलाक बादसँ नेपाल संविधानक माध्यमसँ, ‘आदिवासी राष्ट्रियता आयोग’ स्थापनाक प्रावधान केने राष्ट्रपति बतौलनि । हुनी विश्वास व्यक्त करलकै कि ई संवैधानिक निकाय आदिवासी लोगऽ के गौरवशाली इतिहास, भाषा, आरू संस्कृति के रक्षा करी क॑ ओकरऽ सशक्तिकरण के समर्थन करी रहलऽ छै, आरू ई अपनऽ भूमिका क॑ अधिक प्रभावी ढंग स॑ निभाबै वाला छै ।

राष्ट्रपति के अनुसार आदिवासी राष्ट्रीयता के न्याय आरू अधिकार के अभाव में समृद्ध नेपाल के तरफ यात्रा अपूर्ण रहतै।" लोकतांत्रिक संवाद आरू संवैधानिक प्रक्रिया के माध्यम स॑ विगत के संघर्ष आरू असंतोष के अवशेष के संबोधित करी क॑ स्थायी शांति, सामुदायिक सद्भावना आरू एकता क॑ कायम रखै के साथ राष्ट्रीय अखंडता क॑ आरू मजबूत करलऽ जैतै ।"

ओ एहि बात पर जोर देलनि जे लोकतंत्र मे सब जाति, वर्ग आ पिछड़ल समुदायक अधिकार सुनिश्चित भेल अछि, ई नहि बिसरबाक चाही।

देशी राष्ट्रीयता क॑ ओकरऽ स्वदेशी ज्ञान, कौशल आरू तकनीक के व्यावसायिक रूपांतरण के माध्यम स॑ आर्थिक रूप स॑ सशक्त बनाबै के जरूरत क॑ रेखांकित करतें हुअ॑ राष्ट्रपति न॑ ‘खुला हवा म॑ रहय वाला संग्रहालय’ जैसनऽ अभिनव दृष्टिकोण के कार्यान्वयन के माध्यम स॑ देशी संस्कृति क॑ पर्यटन स॑ जोड़ै के नीति क॑ अपनाबै के जरूरत प॑ दबाव डाललकै ।(आरएसएस)

title: India signs Mutual Legal Assistance Agreement on Criminal Matters with Nepal - newsonair.gov.in
description: India signs Mutual Legal Assistance Agreement on Criminal Matters with Nepal  newsonair.gov.in
publisher.title: newsonair.gov.in
full_article:
An agreement has been reached between India and Nepal on mutual legal assistance on criminal matters. The agreement to this effect was signed by Ambassador of India to Nepal Naveen Srivastava and Nepal’s Joint Secretary at the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Binod Kumar Bhattarai, on behalf of the Government of Nepal.

The agreement on mutual assistance on criminal matters was signed as per the cabinet meeting held on 16 October 2025 in the presence of Anil Kumar Sinha, Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs. The agreement is expected to formally pave the way for cooperation and exchange of matters such as the collection and exchange of evidence during the investigation, prosecution, and judicial proceedings of criminal cases between the concerned authorities of both countries.

The agreement is expected to make a significant contribution to enabling the rule of law and enhancing institutional coordination in the judicial administration. With the implementation of the agreement, collaboration between the central authorities of both countries will become even stronger and more results-oriented.

The agreement serves as a milestone in reducing fiduciary crimes in Nepal and making investigation, prosecution, and justice delivery more effective. The agreement is also expected to further assist in mutual assessments related to the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing. The ceremony was attended by the Ministry Secretary Parashwor Dhungana and representatives from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

title: Nepal Drugs Limited recovers from 25-year crisis, targets 98 free medicines - The Rising Nepal
description: Nepal Drugs Limited recovers from 25-year crisis, targets 98 free medicines  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
By Raman Paudel

Kathmandu, Aug. 10 : Nepal Drugs Limited, which had been closed for a decade, has now returned to profitability.

According to officials at Nepal Drugs Limited, the company is about to distribute at least 22 types of its own medicines to the market in large volumes within the next two months.

Kailash Kumar Paneru, General Manager of the company, said the industry achieved the World Health Organization’s Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standard last year and has become profitable as both production and sales have increased.

“When I came to the company three years ago, the company had outstanding payments to the provident fund and other institutions. Now, it is not only profitable, but this year we have set a target of Rs. 300 million in turnover,” GM Paneru said.

The company, which sold medicines worth Rs. 120 million in 2001, last distributed bonuses to its employees in the same year and faced several challenges over the following 10 years.

In recent years, particularly after signing an MoU with Kathmandu Metropolitan City in 2025, the company has accelerated efforts to expand its market across the country. It later signed a second MoU with Bharatpur Metropolitan City.

According to Paneru, the company initially increased medicine production by signing an agreement with Kathmandu Metropolitan City, which helped it gain access to Provincial Supply Management Centres, local governments and federal hospitals.

The company has now reached agreements with six provinces, excluding Karnali. General Manager Paneru informed that the company has already signed MoUs with most of the municipalities in the Kathmandu Valley.

Recently, the federal government wrote to all local governments across the country asking them to purchase medicines from the company. This is also expected to expand its market across the country.“However, we have created a market not only among government bodies but also in the private sector,” GM Paneru said.

According to him, the company is currently producing 11 different types of medicines. Some are being produced at full capacity, while others are being produced at partial capacity. Production levels, however, will be determined based on market demand.

The company plans to produce 22 types of medicines, particularly essential drugs for conditions such as intestinal worms, diabetes, high blood pressure, thyroid disorders, and cholesterol, which are in high demand in the market. The government, however, has set a target for the company to produce 25 types of medicines.

Earlier, the company’s production was limited to medicines such as Cetaplus, Jeevan Jal and a few other products. Recently, however, the market has begun to expand as production increases, particularly in response to government demand. General Manager Paneru said the company’s presence in both the private market and government supply system has increased significantly.

After upgrading its plant and machinery to meet Good Manufacturing Practice (GM P) standards and obtaining GMP certification last year, the organization has focused its plans on expanding the production of essential medicines and supplying them through government-to-government (G2G) arrangements.

Paneru believes that once these medicines are introduced to the market, the industry’s income and profits will increase significantly. As a long-term goal, the industry has aimed to replace imports of essential medicines.

“The organization’s strategic role in public health security will increase by ensuring the supply of essential medicines such as Cetaplus and Jeevan Jal during disasters such as floods, landslides, COVID-19 and dengue outbreaks,” General Manager Paneru said.

He also claimed that the company is working with the aim of producing all 98 types of medicines that the government distributes free of cost within the next three years.

He expressed confidence that the company will develop into a model pharmaceutical industry in the future and be established as the state’s strategic drug repository.

He further said the process of purchasing the necessary raw materials is currently under way. Work is also under way to install the necessary automated machinery to convert the existing manual system into high-volume automated production and increase production capacity.

General Manager Paneru said preparations are also under way to recruit skilled technical manpower in accordance with the approved Organization and Management (O&M) survey.

Despite these achievements, the industry requires more infrastructure and human resources. “Although demand for medicines produced here has started to increase, there is still a shortage of equipment. The government has allocated a budget of Rs. 240 million in the current fiscal year. With the necessary equipment and additional manpower, we can produce 22 types of medicines,” he said.

How did the industry get into crisis?

The company, which once produced 114 types of medicines, was almost closed in 2007. When 375 employees became unemployed, problems also began to arise regarding the payment of salaries. According to an official, employees were forced to remain inactive for about 10 years.

Even three years ago, the company was facing a severe financial crisis. Employees had not received their regular salaries for three to four months.

An official at the company said it faced challenges for several reasons, including the fact that its medicines did not meet GMP standards.

“Earlier, the Department of Drugs Administration (DDA) had said that Nepal Drugs did not comply with GMP standards, and medicine production was stopped for 10 years. At that time, even though the reasons for non-compliance were identified, it was difficult for the company to operate due to the influence of private drug sellers. Officials at the Nepal Drugs were close to private sellers,” the official told The Rising Nepal on condition of anonymity.

The company, which had been facing various crises for 25 years, has returned to profitability after years of financial difficulties. The company recorded a loss of more than Rs. 100 million in fiscal year 2024/25 but managed to earn a profit of Rs. 30 million a year later, in fiscal year 2025/26.

General Manager Paneru said that after achieving GMP certification, it became easier for the company to pursue G2G arrangements with government agencies.

Govt gives priority to Nepal Drugs

The current government has prioritized Nepal Drugs Limited, which had previously received little state attention, and has emphasized expanding its production capacity. The company has also been included as a priority under the government’s 100-point governance reform programme led by Prime Minister Balendra Shah.

Under the programme, the government aims to gradually enable Nepal Drugs Limited to produce 98 types of free medicines within three years. The company is currently producing Jeevan Jal (ORS) sachets, Metronidazole 400 mg tablets and Cetirizine 10 mg tablets under its essential medicines category.

In addition, it is producing hemodialysis solutions (Part A and Part B), sanitizers, glycerin, Metronidazole DF tablets, Folic Acid 0.4 mg, distilled water, and Cetaplus under its non-essential medicines category.

उद्योग कोना संकट मे आबि गेल।

एक बेर 114 प्रकार क दवाई क उत्पादन करय वाला कंपनी 2007 मे लगभग बंद भ गेल छल।जखन 375 कर्मचारी बेरोजगार भ गेलाह त वेतन क भुगतान क संबंध मे सेहो समस्या पैदा होबय लागल। एकटा अधिकारी क अनुसार कर्मचारी कए करीब 10 साल तक निष्क्रिय रहबा लेल मजबूर कैल गेल।

तीन साल पहिने सेहो कंपनी कए भारी वित्तीय संकट क सामना करय पड़ल छल। तीन स चारि मास स कर्मचारी कए नियमित वेतन नहि भेटैत छल।

कंपनी क एकटा अधिकारी क कहब अछि जे ओकरा कईटा कारण स चुनौती क सामना करय पड़ैत अछि, जाहि मे इ तथ्य सेहो शामिल अछि जे ओकर दवाई जीएमपी मानक पर खरा नहि उतरैत अछि।

“पहिने औषधि प्रशासन विभाग (डीडीए) कहने छल जे नेपाल औषधि जीएमपी मानकक पालन नहि करैत अछि, आ दवाई उत्पादन १० वर्ष धरि बंद कएल गेल छल । ओहि समय अनुपालन नहि करबाक कारण क पहचान भ गेलाक बादो निजी दवाई बेचनिहार क प्रभाव क कारण कंपनी कए काज करब मुश्किल भ गेल छल। नेपाल ड्रग्स के अधिकारी निजी विक्रेता के करीबी छल।’ अधिकारी नाम नहि बताबय के शर्त पर द राइजिंग नेपाल के कहलनि।

25 साल स विभिन्न संकट क सामना करय वाला कंपनी सालों स आर्थिक कठिनाई क बाद मुनाफा मे वापस आबि गेल अछि। कंपनी कए 100 टका स बेसी क घाटा दर्ज कैल गेल। वित्तीय वर्ष 2024/25 मे 10 करोड़ टका देल गेल मुदा 10 करोड़ टका क मुनाफा कमाए मे सफल रहल। 3 करोड़ एक साल बाद, वित्तीय वर्ष 2025/26 मे।

महाप्रबंधक पनेरु नँ कहलकै कि जीएमपी प्रमाणीकरण हासिल करला के बाद कंपनी लेली सरकारी एजेंसी के साथ जी टू जी के व्यवस्था करना आसान होय गेलै ।

नेपाल ड्रग्स के प्राथमिकता देल गेल सरकार

वर्तमान सरकार नेपाल ड्रग्स लिमिटेड के प्राथमिकता देलक अछि, जेकरा पहिने राज्य के कम ध्यान देल गेल छल, आ उत्पादन क्षमता के विस्तार पर जोर देल गेल अछि. प्रधानमंत्री बलेन्द्र शाह के नेतृत्व मे सरकार के 100 सूत्री शासन सुधार कार्यक्रम के तहत सेहो कंपनी के प्राथमिकता के रूप मे शामिल कएल गेल अछि.

एहि कार्यक्रम के तहत सरकार के लक्ष्य अछि जे नेपाल ड्रग्स लिमिटेड के धीरे-धीरे तीन साल के भीतर 98 प्रकार के मुफ्त दवाई के उत्पादन करय मे सक्षम बनाबय के अछि. कंपनी एखन अपन आवश्यक दवाई श्रेणी मे जीवन जल (ओआरएस) पाउच, मेट्रोनिडाजोल 400 मिलीग्राम गोली आ सेटिरिजिन 10 मिलीग्राम गोली क उत्पादन क रहल अछि।

एकरऽ अलावा ई अपनऽ गैर-आवश्यक दवाई श्रेणी के तहत हीमोडायलिसिस घोल (भाग ए आरू भाग बी), सेनेटाइजर, ग्लिसरीन, मेट्रोनिडाजोल डीएफ गोली, फोलिक एसिड 0.4 मिलीग्राम, आसुत पानी, आरू सेटाप्लस के उत्पादन करी रहलऽ छै ।

full_article:
By Our Correspondent

Parasi, Aug. 10: As erosion by the Narayani River intensifies, residents of Susta village in West Nawalparasi have begun efforts to protect their settlement using their own labour and locally available resources.

Although the tendering process for the construction of a permanent embankment had been completed, work was halted after it was reportedly obstructed from across the border, prompting local residents to build a temporary embankment.

As the river’s flow has begun to shift towards the settlement, residents of Susta, along with the Nepali Army, Nepal Police and Armed Police Force, have been deployed to control the river. Temporary structures are being built in the eroded areas using sand-filled sacks, gabion wire mesh and tree branches.

Local residents are carrying sandbags and managing other materials through voluntary community labour. Security personnel are stationed along the riverbank and assisting efforts to control the erosion.

According to Rabindra Jaiswal, spokesperson for the Susta Protection Campaign, the tendering process for the construction of a permanent embankment to control the erosion had already been completed. However, the work could not proceed because of obstruction from the Indian side, he said.

“The construction of the permanent embankment, for which the contract has already been awarded, has been halted because of obstruction from the Indian side. As the risk of the river’s flow shifting towards the settlement has increased, we are now building a temporary embankment using local resources and voluntary community labour,” Jaiswal said.

Every year, erosion by the Narayani River puts farmland and settlements in Susta at risk. Although the river continues to erode the land annually, the failure to construct a permanent embankment has left local residents fearful during the monsoon.

As the erosion intensified, a team comprising federal lawmaker Bikram Khanal, Chief District Officer Dipak Raj Nepal and the heads of the district’s security agencies visited Susta for an on-site inspection. The team assessed the condition of the erosion-affected area and the potential risks.

During the inspection, Susta residents urged the authorities to immediately carry out temporary river-control measures to protect their homes, farmland and settlement from erosion, and to take initiatives for a long-term solution. They also called for the obstruction from across the border to be removed after the monsoon so that construction of the permanent embankment could proceed.

Khanal said necessary coordination was being carried out with the Ministry of Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation to ensure the resources required for construction of the embankment.

CDO Nepal said the local administration, elected representatives and security agencies had been placed on high alert to minimise potential damage from erosion by the Narayani River. He said temporary control measures had been adopted for the time being and additional personnel would be mobilised according to the level of risk.

Every year, local residents have been contributing voluntary labour to protect their settlement and farmland from river erosion.

परासी, 10 अगस्त : नारायणी नदी के कटाव तेज होय के साथ-साथ पश्चिम नवलपरासी के सुस्ता गाँव के निवासी न॑ अपनऽ श्रम आरू स्थानीय रूप स॑ उपलब्ध संसाधन के उपयोग करी क॑ अपनऽ बस्ती के सुरक्षा के प्रयास शुरू करी देल॑ छै ।

हालांकि स्थायी तटबंध के निर्माण के निविदा प्रक्रिया पूरा भ गेल छल, मुदा सीमा पार स बाधा पहुंचला के बाद काज बंद भ गेल छल, जाहि स स्थानीय निवासी अस्थायी तटबंध बनेलथि।

नदी के बहाव बस्ती दिस बढ़य लागल अछि, एहि सं नदी पर नियंत्रण के लेल नेपाली सेना, नेपाल पुलिस आ सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल के संग सुस्ता के निवासी के तैनात कएल गेल अछि. कटाव वाला इलाका मे बालू सं भरल बोरा, गैबियन तार के जाली आ गाछ के डारि के उपयोग सं अस्थायी संरचना बनाओल जा रहल अछि.

स्थानीय निवासी स्वैच्छिक सामुदायिक श्रम के माध्यम स बालू के थैली ल क अन्य सामग्री के प्रबंधन क रहल छैथ। सुरक्षाकर्मी नदी के किनारे तैनात छै आरू कटाव क॑ नियंत्रित करै के प्रयास म॑ सहायता करी रहलऽ छै ।

सुस्ता संरक्षण अभियान के प्रवक्ता रवीन्द्र जायसवाल के अनुसार कटाव पर नियंत्रण के लेल स्थायी तटबंध के निर्माण के निविदा प्रक्रिया पूरा भ चुकल छल। मुदा भारतीय पक्ष स बाधा के कारण काज आगू नहि बढ़ि सकल ओ कहलनि।

जयसवाल कहलनि जे, स्थायी तटबंध के निर्माण, जकरा लेल ठेका पहिने सं देल जा चुकल अछि, भारतीय दिस सं बाधा के कारण बंद भ गेल अछि, जेना-जेना नदी के बहाव बस्ती दिस बढ़बाक खतरा बढ़ल अछि, हम सब आब स्थानीय संसाधन आ स्वैच्छिक सामुदायिक श्रम के उपयोग क अस्थायी तटबंध बना रहल छी।

हर साल नारायणी नदी केरऽ कटाव स॑ सुस्ता केरऽ खेती के जमीन आरू बस्ती खतरा म॑ पड़ै छै । हालांकि नदी सालाना जमीन कए कटाव जारी रखैत अछि, मुदा स्थायी तटबंध नहि बनेबा स मानसून क दौरान स्थानीय निवासी कए आतंकित भ गेल अछि।

कटाव तेज होइते संघीय विधायक बिक्रम खनाल, मुख्य जिल्ला अधिकारी दीपक राज नेपाल आ जिल्लाक सुरक्षा एजेन्सी प्रमुखसभक टोली स्थलगत निरीक्षणक लेल सुस्ता गेल छल । टीम कटाव प्रभावित क्षेत्र क स्थिति आ संभावित जोखिम क आकलन केलक।

निरीक्षण के दौरान सुस्ता के निवासी नँ अधिकारियौ स॑ आग्रह करलकै कि तुरंत अपनऽ घर, खेती के जमीन आरू बस्ती क॑ कटाव स॑ बचाबै लेली अस्थायी नदी-नियंत्रण उपाय करलऽ जाय, आरू एकरऽ दीर्घकालिक समाधान लेली पहल करलऽ जाय । संगहि मानसून के बाद सीमा पार स आबय वाला बाधा के हटाबय के आह्वान केलनि जाहि सं स्थायी तटबंध के निर्माण आगू बढ़ि सकय.

खनाल कहलनि जे, तटबंध निर्माण लेल आवश्यक संसाधन सुनिश्चित करबाक लेल ऊर्जा, जल संसाधन आ सिंचाई मंत्रालय के संग आवश्यक समन्वय कायल जा रहल अछि।

सीडीओ नेपाल कहलनि जे, नारायणी नदी द्वारा कटाव सँ संभावित क्षति कम सँ कम करबाक लेल स्थानीय प्रशासन, निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधि आ सुरक्षा निकाय केँ हाई अलर्ट मे राखल गेल अछि। ओ कहलनि जे, फिलहाल अस्थायी नियंत्रण के उपाय अपनाओल गेल अछि आ जोखिम के स्तर के हिसाब सं अतिरिक्त कर्मी के जुटाओल जायत।

हर साल स्थानीय निवासी अपन बस्ती आ खेती के जमीन के नदी के कटाव सं बचाबय लेल स्वैच्छिक श्रम के योगदान दैत आबि रहल छथिन्ह.

full_article:
By A Staff Reporter

Kathmandu, Aug. 10: President of the Nepal Olympic Committee, Jeevan Ram Shrestha, said that instability has hindered the progress and success that should have been achieved in Nepali sports.

Speaking at the seventh annual general assembly of the Nepal Ski Association on Sunday, President Shrestha stressed that if everyone works honestly within the legal framework, instability in sports can be overcome, enabling associations to confidently advance the development of sport.

He expressed optimism that recent changes in the country would bring positive transformation in the sports sector. “Ending uncertainty, instability, and interference would pave the way for sporting development and enhance national pride,” he said.

Shrestha, who is also the President of the Ski Association, stated that the Association is putting all its efforts into developing skiing in Nepal.

He noted that although not all intended goals have been achieved, every possible attempt is being made. “Despite Nepal being home to the Himalayas, including the world’s highest mountain, Mt Sagarmatha, winter sports remain little known in the nation,” he said. “If skiing can be developed, Nepal could become a destination for ski tourism,” Shrestha added.

Vice-President Rama Bhattarai thanked all those who have supported the promotion of the sport. General Secretary Bijaya Shrestha acknowledged the challenges of skiing in Nepal but affirmed that the Association is working to promote the sport as much as possible.

The inaugural ceremony was also addressed by Deepak Devkota, President of the Nepal Rugby Association; Pitambar Timilsina, President of the Nepal Handball Association; Chaturanan Rajvaidya, Vice-President of the NOC; Rajiv Shrestha, General Secretary of the NOC; and Dhan Shahi, representative of the National Sports Council.

During the event, the Association also unveiled Snowline, a magazine featuring ski activities and articles.

The closed session of the Association endorsed an annual budget of Rs. 34,808,800 for the fiscal year 2083–84. The budget has been allocated for organising national competitions, participating in international events, conducting training programmes, and preparing for the Winter Olympics.

The session also approved the work plan presented by Vice-President Rama Bhattarai, the annual report submitted by General Secretary Bijaya Shrestha, and the financial report presented by Treasurer Jitendra Shrestha.

Officials and members of the Ski Association participated both physically and virtually in the assembly. The Association’s new statute allows members unable to attend in person to join the assembly virtually.

काठमांडू, 10 अगस्त : नेपाल ओलम्पिक समितिक अध्यक्ष जीवन राम श्रेष्ठ नेपाली खेल मे जे प्रगति आ सफलता भेटबाक चाही छल ताहि मे अस्थिरता बाधित भेल बतौलनि ।

रविदिन नेपाल स्की संघके सातम वार्षिक आम सभामे बजैत राष्ट्रपति श्रेष्ठ जौं सब कियो कानूनी ढांचामे ईमानदारीसँ काज करए तऽ खेलमे अस्थिरता दूर कएल जा सकैत अछि, जाहिसँ संघ सभ आत्मविश्वाससँ खेलक विकासमे आगू बढि सकैत अछि ।

ओ आशा व्यक्त केलथि जे देश मे हाल मे आयल बदलाव स खेल क्षेत्र मे सकारात्मक परिवर्तन आओत। हुनी कहलकै, 'अनिश्चितता, अस्थिरता, आरू हस्तक्षेप के समाप्त करला स॑ खेल विकास के रास्ता खुलतै आरू राष्ट्रीय गौरव बढ़तै ।

स्की एसोसिएशन के अध्यक्ष सेहो रहल श्रेष्ठ नेपाल मे स्कीइंग के विकास मे अपन पूरा प्रयास लगा रहल बतौलनि ।

हुनी नोट करलकै कि भले ही सब इरादा के लक्ष्य पूरा नै होय सकलौ छै, लेकिन हर संभव प्रयास करलौ जाय रहलौ छै । ओ कहलनि जे, नेपाल मे विश्व के सबस ऊँच पहाड़ माउंट सागरमाथा सहित हिमालय के घर रहला के बावजूद शीतकालीन खेल के नाम राष्ट्र मे बहुत कम अछि। श्रेष्ठ कहलनि जे, जौं स्कीइंग के विकास भ सकैत अछि त नेपाल स्की पर्यटन के गंतव्य बनि सकैत अछि।

उपराष्ट्रपति रामा भट्टराई खेलके प्रचार प्रसार मे सहयोग देनिहार सब गोटेके धन्यवाद देलखिन । महासचिव विजया श्रेष्ठ नेपाल मे स्कीइंग के चुनौती के स्वीकार केलनि मुदा संघ एहि खेल के यथासंभव बढ़ावा देबय लेल काज क रहल अछि से पुष्टि केलनि।

उद्घाटन समारोहमे नेपाल रग्बी संघके अध्यक्ष दीपक देवकोटा; नेपाल हैण्डबॉल संघके अध्यक्ष पीताम्बर तिमिलसिना डा. चतुरानन राजवैद्य, एनओसी के उपाध्यक्ष, प्रो. राजीव श्रेष्ठ, एनओसी के महासचिव, प्रो. एवं राष्ट्रीय खेल परिषद के प्रतिनिधि धन शाही।

ई आयोजन के दौरान एसोसिएशन न॑ स्नोलाइन नाम केरऽ पत्रिका के अनावरण भी करलकै, जेकरा म॑ स्की गतिविधि आरू लेख शामिल छै ।

एसोसिएशन के बंद सत्र में 1000 रुपया के वार्षिक बजट के समर्थन कायल गेल। वित्तीय वर्ष 2083-84 के लिये 34,808,800 रुपये। ई बजट राष्ट्रीय प्रतियोगिता के आयोजन, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय आयोजनऽ म॑ भाग लेबै, प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रम के संचालन, आरू शीतकालीन ओलंपिक के तैयारी लेली आवंटित करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

सत्रमे उपाध्यक्ष राम भट्टराई द्वारा प्रस्तुत कार्ययोजना, महासचिव विजय श्रेष्ठ द्वारा प्रस्तुत वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन, आ कोषाध्यक्ष जितेन्द्र श्रेष्ठ द्वारा प्रस्तुत वित्तीय प्रतिवेदनके अनुमोदन सेहो कएल गेल अछि ।

स्की एसोसिएशन केरऽ अधिकारी आरू सदस्य न॑ ई सभा म॑ शारीरिक आरू वर्चुअल दोनों तरह स॑ भाग लेलकै । एसोसिएशन केरऽ नया विधान म॑ व्यक्तिगत रूप स॑ उपस्थित नै होय वाला सदस्यऽ क॑ वर्चुअल रूप स॑ विधानसभा म॑ शामिल होय के अनुमति देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।
